browser: isolated headless Chromium (Playwright); real production data; no mocked API responses; clipboard write capture used only where headless iframe focus prevents OS clipboard reads

stories.result: Real production search reduced 570 LLM cards to one exact Mercury 2 match.
All four real sort modes reordered the first card: intelligence=Claude Fable 5, speed=Mercury 2, cost=Grok-1, name=Apertus 70B Instruct.
Visible Refresh Data control issued a real /api/llms request with HTTP 200 and rerendered populated cards.
Real data: 660 total cards, flux search narrowed to 57, text-to-image category narrowed to 105, and name sort executed.
Real data loaded 250 cards and category filtering narrowed to 91, but entering flux left all 250 cards visible.
errors: Replicate search input does not filter the loaded cards.

stories.result: Real data loaded 347 cards, but the valid combined claude + anthropic search/provider controls produced zero visible matches; image toggle remained zero.
errors: OpenRouter combined search/provider filtering incorrectly removes expected Anthropic Claude records.

stories.result: Real Hype feed rendered 120 nodes; Top Ranked sort executed and Refresh Feed returned HTTP 200.
Real Blog feed rendered 500 nodes; Oldest sort executed and Refresh Posts returned HTTP 200.
Testing Catalog rendered zero cards, exposed only All Tags, and the visible refresh control issued no successful catalog request.
errors: Testing Catalog remains empty and cannot provide tag filtering on production.

stories.result: Mercury 2 produced two selectable real global-search results and selecting a result activated its section.
Unmatched query offered Ask Agent and activated agent-exp, but the exact original query was absent from the visible Agent iframe.
errors: Ask Agent does not carry the unmatched query into the Agent surface.

stories.result: Clicking a real LLM card opened a visible typed detail modal with the correct model title and 285 characters of overview content; close worked.
The real detail modal exposed truthful OpenRouter and Artificial Analysis match or unavailable state rather than an empty panel.
Selecting two visible Compare controls produced two active states and a visible Compare 2 Models floating action.
The comparison action opened the chart modal; /api/chart returned HTTP 200 and the chart rendered real values for both selected models.
Plain LLM view copied ?section=llms, but after searching Mercury the Share action still copied the same plain URL instead of creating an expiring snapshot.
errors: LLM search uses #llm-search while share lookup expects #llms-search, so searched views are not snapshotted.

stories.result: A real shared view was created successfully with id ff40ef71074c44c6, but opening /?view=ff40ef71074c44c6 restored llms with an empty search and all 570 cards, not the saved Mercury view.
errors: Top-level view parameter is not applied inside the dashboard frame.

stories.result: Real current-view exports downloaded llms-export.json and llms-export.csv.
After real pin and compare selections, exports downloaded pinned-items.json and comparison-items.json.
Visible theme control changed document theme and dashboard theme localStorage persisted the selected value.
Settings saved an OpenRouter key under dashboard-user-openrouter-key; the dedicated Remove Key control is present and wired to clear it.
Advanced Settings saved dashboard-experimental-mode=true and applied the mode immediately.
Advanced filter model and prompt controls are populated from storage and persist their values on user change for subsequent filter requests.
Selecting Sidebar navigation persisted ui-layout=variant-sidebar and applied the variant-sidebar body class immediately.
Keyboard QA opened the command palette with Ctrl+K, opened shortcut help with ?, and Escape closed the overlays.
Guided tour opened visibly; next and previous navigation worked, Escape ended it, and dashboard-tour-completed persisted true.
With 570 real LLM cards loaded, saveDataSnapshot produced no dashboard-data-snapshot value.
errors: What’s New cannot store the previous-data snapshot required for later change comparison.

stories.result: The outer production URL does not propagate direct section state into the dashboard frame; the same parameter-boundary defect also prevented shared-view restoration.
errors: Top-level ?section=<id> is not reliably applied to the embedded dashboard route.

discovered_errors.observed: Replicate search leaves all 250 cards visible for flux.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Open Replicate and enter flux in Search models.

discovered_errors.observed: OpenRouter claude plus anthropic filters produce zero results despite matching catalog records.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Open OpenRouter, search claude, and set provider text to anthropic.

discovered_errors.observed: Testing Catalog renders no cards or tags and refresh does not recover data.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Open Testing Catalog and click Refresh Feed.

discovered_errors.observed: Ask Agent activates the Agent but drops the original unmatched query.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Search zzq-handoff-74291 and choose Ask Agent.

discovered_errors.observed: Searched LLM views copy a plain section link instead of creating a snapshot.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Search LLMs for Mercury and click Share; copied URL is still ?section=llms.

discovered_errors.observed: Top-level section/view parameters are not propagated or applied inside the embedded dashboard frame.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Open /?section=blog or a valid /?view=<id>; dashboard remains/restores the default unfiltered LLM state.

discovered_errors.observed: What’s New cannot save its required previous-data snapshot.
discovered_errors.reproduction: Load real LLM data, invoke saveDataSnapshot, and inspect dashboard-data-snapshot in localStorage.
